outline.title: Outline
outline.sectionLabel: {title}, from {start}, {duration}, {count, plural, one {# clip} other {# clips}}
outline.addSectionsHint: Puts the first clip in Intro, the last in Outro and the rest in Body
outline.dragClip: Drag to move, also into another section (Alt+↑/↓ with the keyboard)
outline.dragSection: Drag to move the section with its clips (Alt+↑/↓ with the keyboard); double-click the name to rename it (F2)
outline.tooMany: Too many clips for one change (at most {max} steps at once)
